title: Easterlies to bring rains to Eastern, Central Visayas on Nov. 11

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Eastern and Central Visayas will experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms on Wednesday, November 11, due to the prevailing easterlies. In its daily public weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Atmospheric Services Administration (Pagasa) warned that moderate to at times heavy rains could trigger flash floods or landslides. The rest of Visayas, along with Occidental Mindoro and Palawan, including the Kalayaan Islands, will have partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms.
